versions.changelog:
Initial release of ebrun-original-news skill:

- Provides latest original e-commerce news from 亿邦动力网 by channel or topic.
- Supports natural language triggering, auto-matching main/sub-channels from user input.
- Returns up to 10 latest articles with title, author, summary, publish time, and link.
- Includes robust fallback to "推荐" channel if unable to match input.
- Version update check runs in the background with clear user prompts if new versions are available.
- Includes Python and shell scripts for data fetching and version updates; handles errors gracefully.
